headline: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; backup Bagent back at practice
summary: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.

summary: The final years of Aaron Rodgers's career aren't going as well as the rest of it.

headline: A win on Sunday would tie Dak Prescott with Roger Staubach for second on Cowboys' all-time list
summary: Last week, Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott set the team's all-time passing touchdown record.

headline: Matt Judon, three others work out for 49ers with Nick Bosa injured
summary: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa is out for Sunday's game with a calf injury and he is expected to miss more time, so the team looked at a few options to bolster the position on Saturday.
